make = np.random.default_rng
a = make(42).normal(size=3)
b = make(42).normal(size=3)
c = make().normal(size=3)
d = make().normal(size=3)

np.array_equal(a, b)   # True
np.array_equal(c, d)   # False
caption: Seeded generators repeat exactly; unseeded ones almost never do.
